title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
summary: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

title: Wall Street analysts urge investors to buy crypto stocks after $6.3 billion Binance hack
summary: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the $6.3 billion Binance hack is unlikely to derail the crypto market's recovery.

title: Binance arranges $6.34 billion to cover losses from record crypto hack
summary: Binance said it reserved its own funds to cover the $6.3 billion hack, including freezes of roughly $3 billion in stolen assets.

title: Here's how big bitcoin traders responded after the Binance hack hit
Here’s how an Ethereum upgrade helped drain part of Binance’s $6 billion loss
summary: On Ethereum, the attacker used a 2025 upgrade built to make ordinary wallets smarter, armed with 50 signatures from Binance's own wallet.
